name: How do I choose a sewage damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a sewage damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a sewage damage restoration company, look for certifications from organizations like the IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification), indicating they meet industry standards. Ensure they offer 24/7 emergency services, have experienced technicians, and are transparent about their process and pricing. Check for local references and read reviews to gauge their reliability and customer service. A reputable company will also assist with insurance claims documentation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company with IICRC certifications, 24/7 emergency service, experienced technicians, transparent pricing, and good local reviews. They should also assist with insurance claims.
